messages:
Alex: heads-up — ran the node sample app during onboarding and noticed logs flip to DEBUG once the otel exporter attaches. looks noisy in prod.
Mira: ugh seen that before with an older sdk. repro steps?
Alex: start with NODE_ENV=production, SDK v0.8.1, REDWOOD_TELEMETRY=1. then trigger an auth refresh (401)->retry. logs show two different request_ids for the same external call.
Sam: can you paste a snippet? guessing auth retry is creating a new req id instead of reusing the original.
Alex: paste: ```
INFO  auth: fetched token
DEBUG http: req_id=abcd1234 -> calling /models/generate
WARN  http: 401 from /models/generate
DEBUG http: req_id=efgh5678 -> retrying /models/generate
```
Alex: also noticed a multiline payload containing backticked secrets is NOT being redacted when otel hook runs during retry.
Julio: looks like two separate issues: (1) retry path not preserving trace/request id, (2) otel hook auto-init is re-binding logger level and running redaction after some middleware has already logged raw payload.
Mira: for (1) we should pass the original req_id in the retry context (like x-redwood-original-reqid) and prefer it if present. small change in auth middleware.
Sam: agree. low-risk: set retry to reuse context.requestId || generate. also add test for idempotent headers and reqid propagation.
Alex: for (2) is the redaction ordering deterministic? I saw the redaction hook run twice in a row and the first run happened before we normalized the body.
Julio: otel-autoinit attaches early; it wraps the logger and exporter, which toggles level to DEBUG when exporter debug logging is enabled. that then causes middleware to emit full payload before our redaction transform runs.
Mira: so fix options: 1) make redaction run as a sync pre-hook earlier in the pipeline, 2) avoid otel changing log level by default, 3) ensure exporter debug flag comes from env not auto-on.
Sam: +1 to making redaction synchronous and earliest. Also we should add a guard to redact inside the logger itself as a last resort.
Alex: filed a tiny repro in the sampleapp repo: https://stash.internal/sampleapp/telemetry/repro-reqid-redact (private).
Julio: i'm going to open a PR to: reuse req_id on retry, add sync redact pre-hook, and add a unit test simulating otel auto-init. assign to @Sam for review.
Sam: thanks. will review today. can we also add an e2e in the telemetry ci matrix that runs with OTEL_AUTO_INIT=1 and SDK v0.8.x so this doesn't regress?
Mira: yes please. add a flaky label if it flakes.
infra-bot: CI queued for sampleapp/telemetry (runs: unit, e2e-telemetry).
devx-bot: FYI: created ticket DX-1124 "preserve-request-id-on-retry + redact ordering with otel-autoinit" and linked PR #452.
Alex: sweet. can we also document the mitigation in the onboarding guide (short note: set OTEL_AUTO_INIT=0 if you want stable levels)? new users tripped on this.
Mira: will add a short note to docs/telemetry.md.
Sam: after PR merged, i'll cut a patch release and post in #eng-runtime. :thumbsup:
Alex: thanks all — great catch.
